QuestInfo.name: Checking on Ellinia
QuestInfo.0: Athena Pierce has a request for you.
QuestInfo.1: You must prepare for the Black Mage's imminent return. \r\nMeet Grendel the Really Old in Ellinia to see how things are going there.
QuestInfo.2: You go to meet Dances with Grendel the Really Old in Ellinia. He says everything's fine.

0.0: We can't rest easy yet,  #h0#. There is more work to be done.
0.1: The Black Mage's resurrection is imminent. The Explorers of the Maple Alliance need to be ready.
0.2: So I want you to check with #bGrendel the Really Old#k in Ellinia and make sure everything's in tip-top shape.

yes.0: Every town must be prepared, but we have so little time...

1.0: No strange omens cloud Ellinia's light. We are at prepared to battle for peace.

yes.0: The peace will be eternal! Tell Athena Pierce to rest easy.

npc.0: I want you to check with #bGrendel the Really Old#k in Ellinia and make sure everything's in tip-top shape.
